thread:
Zoe (Design): quick drop 1: slimline action rail for p95 card: timeframe, sampling badge, and copy. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/slim/latency-rail

Zoe (Design): question: sampling as badge (1/10) or tiny label (Samp 1/10)? want minimal wrap in dense dashboards.

Mark (Eng): badge is lighter. implement as a single button that opens a popover with presets. fewer tab stops if we keep actions grouped.

Tara (PM): ops wants copy easily discoverable. prefer copy icon on the right. maybe flip to left when card is pinned.

Liam (A11y): accessibility: ensure badge has aria-label ("Sampling: one in ten") and popover moves focus. toast must be aria-live polite. add sr-only legend text for heatmap.

Zoe (Design): will use "Adaptive sampling" copy in tooltip and aria attributes. add pattern samples to the legend artboard.

Mark (Eng): tech notes: navigator.clipboard.writeText(csv) + ux-bot toast. add 5s client-side throttle and telemetry events: slimrail_copy and sampling_changed.

Tara (PM): feature-flag rollout, capture compact vs expanded in events. keep props low-cardinality.

Zoe (Design): will update figma with badge states, popover layouts, and the a11y checklist. ping when ready.

ux-bot: uploaded 2 assets to staging/latency/slim-rail/ (build 2026-04-06T12:00Z)

Liam (A11y): happy to review strings and focus flows once posted.

Zoe (Design): end.
